description: Gather information about EC2 Auto Scaling Groups (ASGs) in AWS.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The prefix or name of the auto scaling group(s) you are searching for. Note: This is a regular expression match with implicit ‘^’ (beginning of string). Append ‘$’ for a complete name match.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary/hash of tags in the format { tag1_name: ‘tag1_value’, tag2_name: ‘tag2_value’ } to match against the auto scaling group(s) you are searching for.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

- name: Find all groups
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
  register: asgs

- name: Find a group with matching name/prefix
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
    name: public-webserver-asg
  register: asgs

- name: Find a group with matching tags
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
    tags:
      project: webapp
      env: production
  register: asgs

- name: Find a group with matching name/prefix and tags
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
    name: myproject
    tags:
      env: production
  register: asgs

- name: Fail if no groups are found
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
    name: public-webserver-asg
  register: asgs
  failed_when: "{{ asgs.results | length == 0 }}"

- name: Fail if more than 1 group is found
  amazon.aws.autoscaling_group_info:
    name: public-webserver-asg
  register: asgs
  failed_when: "{{ asgs.results | length > 1 }}"

return_values.name: results
return_values.description: A list of Auto Scaling Groups. Returned: always

return_values.name: auto_scaling_group_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name of the ASG. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:autoscaling:us-west-2:123456789012:autoScalingGroup:10787c52-0bcb-427d-82ba-c8e4b008ed2e:autoScalingGroupName/dev11"

return_values.name: auto_scaling_group_name
return_values.description: Name of autoscaling group. Returned: success Sample: "public-webapp-production-1"

return_values.name: availability_zones
return_values.description: List of Availability Zones that are enabled for this ASG. Returned: success Sample: ["us-west-2a", "us-west-2b", "us-west-2a"]

return_values.name: created_time
return_values.description: The date and time this ASG was created, in ISO 8601 format. Returned: success Sample: "2015-11-25T00:05:36.309Z"

return_values.name: default_cooldown
return_values.description: The default cooldown time in seconds. Returned: success Sample: 300

return_values.name: desired_capacity
return_values.description: The number of EC2 instances that should be running in this group. Returned: success Sample: 3

return_values.name: enabled_metrics
return_values.description: The metrics enabled for the group. Returned: success Sample: [{"granularity": "1Minute", "metric": "GroupAndWarmPoolTotalCapacity"}]

return_values.name: granularity
return_values.description: The granularity of the metric. The only valid value is 1Minute. Returned: success Sample: "1Minute"

return_values.name: metric
return_values.description: Name of the metric. Returned: success Sample: "GroupAndWarmPoolTotalCapacity"

return_values.name: health_check_grace_period
return_values.description: Length of time in seconds after a new EC2 instance comes into service that Auto Scaling starts checking its health. Returned: success Sample: 300

return_values.name: health_check_type
return_values.description: The service you want the health status from, one of “EC2” or “ELB”. Returned: success Sample: "ELB"

return_values.name: instances
return_values.description: List of EC2 instances associated with ASG and their status. Returned: success Sample: [{"availability_zone": "us-west-2a", "health_status": "Healthy", "instance_id": "i-es22ad25", "launch_configuration_name": "public-webapp-production-1", "launch_template": {"launch_template_id": "lt-0b19eb00123456789", "launch_template_name": "test-template", "version": "1"}, "lifecycle_state": "InService", "protected_from_scale_in": "false"}]

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: The Availability Zone of the instance. Returned: success Sample: "ap-southeast-2a"

return_values.name: health_status
return_values.description: The last reported health status of the instance. Returned: success Sample: "Healthy"

return_values.name: instance_id
return_values.description: The ID of the instance. Returned: success Sample: "i-012345678"

return_values.name: instance_type
return_values.description: The instance type size of the running instance. Returned: success Sample: "t2.micro"

return_values.name: launch_template
return_values.description: The EC2 launch template to base instance configuration on. Returned: success

return_values.name: launch_template_id
return_values.description: The ID of the launch template. Returned: success

return_values.name: launch_template_name
return_values.description: The name of the launch template. Returned: success

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: The specific version of the launch template to use. Returned: success

return_values.name: lifecycle_state
return_values.description: A description of the current lifecycle state. Returned: success

return_values.name: protected_from_scale_in
return_values.description: Indicates whether the instance is protected from termination by Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling when scaling in. Returned: success

return_values.name: launch_config_name
return_values.description: Name of launch configuration associated with the ASG. Same as launch_configuration_name, provided for compatibility with amazon.aws.autoscaling_group module. Returned: success Sample: "public-webapp-production-1"

return_values.name: launch_configuration_name
return_values.description: Name of launch configuration associated with the ASG. Returned: success Sample: "public-webapp-production-1"

return_values.name: lifecycle_hooks
return_values.description: List of lifecycle hooks for the ASG. Returned: success Sample: [{"AutoScalingGroupName": "public-webapp-production-1", "DefaultResult": "ABANDON", "GlobalTimeout": 172800, "HeartbeatTimeout": 3600, "LifecycleHookName": "instance-launch", "LifecycleTransition": "autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCHING"}, {"AutoScalingGroupName": "public-webapp-production-1", "DefaultResult": "ABANDON", "GlobalTimeout": 172800, "HeartbeatTimeout": 3600, "LifecycleHookName": "instance-terminate", "LifecycleTransition": "autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING"}]

return_values.name: load_balancer_names
return_values.description: List of load balancers names attached to the ASG. Returned: success Sample: ["elb-webapp-prod"]

return_values.name: max_size
return_values.description: Maximum size of group. Returned: success Sample: 3

return_values.name: min_size
return_values.description: Minimum size of group. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: new_instances_protected_from_scale_in
return_values.description: Whether or not new instances a protected from automatic scaling in. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: placement_group
return_values.description: Placement group into which instances are launched, if any. Returned: success Sample: "None"

return_values.name: service_linked_role_arn
return_values.description: The ARN of the service-linked role that the Auto Scaling group uses to call other Amazon Web Services on your behalf. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:iam::721234567890:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The current state of the group when DeleteAutoScalingGroup is in progress. Returned: success Sample: "None"

return_values.name: suspended_processes
return_values.description: The suspended processes associated with the group. Returned: success Sample: [{"process_name": "AddToLoadBalancer", "suspension_reason": "User suspended at 2018-08-30T14:11:58Z"}]

return_values.name: process_name
return_values.description: The name of the suspended process. Returned: success

return_values.name: suspension_reason
return_values.description: The reason that the process was suspended. Returned: success

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: List of tags for the ASG, and whether or not each tag propagates to instances at launch. Returned: success Sample: [{"key": "Name", "propagate_at_launch": "true", "resource_id": "public-webapp-production-1", "resource_type": "auto-scaling-group", "value": "public-webapp-production-1"}, {"key": "env", "propagate_at_launch": "true", "resource_id": "public-webapp-production-1", "resource_type": "auto-scaling-group", "value": "production"}]

return_values.name: target_group_arns
return_values.description: List of ARNs of the target groups that the ASG populates. Returned: success Sample: ["arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-southeast-2:123456789012:targetgroup/target-group-host-hello/1a2b3c4d5e6f1a2b", "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-southeast-2:123456789012:targetgroup/target-group-path-world/abcd1234abcd1234"]

return_values.name: target_group_names
return_values.description: List of names of the target groups that the ASG populates. Returned: success Sample: ["target-group-host-hello", "target-group-path-world"]

return_values.name: termination_policies
return_values.description: A list of termination policies for the group. Returned: success Sample: ["Default"]

return_values.name: traffic_sources
return_values.description: The traffic sources associated with this Auto Scaling group. Returned: success Sample: [{"identifier": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:721234567890:targetgroup/Check-Exter-A4XXXXXXXXXX/8aXXXXXXXXXXXXXX", "type": "elbv2"}]

return_values.name: identifier
return_values.description: Identifies the traffic source. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Provides additional context for the value of Identifier. Returned: success

return_values.name: vpc_zone_identifier
return_values.description: One or more subnet IDs, if applicable, separated by commas. Returned: success Sample: "subnet-0352db1247ae60b40,subnet-01f266bb9928ddaee"
